instruction:
Task: Click the toggle switch when it is in 'Day Mode'.
Expected Result: The toggle smoothly animates to 'Night Mode': the background transitions to a dark blue/black gradient with twinkling stars, the sun element slides out as the moon element (circular with craters, with a subtle glow/shadow) slides in to the right side of the toggle, and the label below updates to display 'Night Mode'.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: The toggle smoothly animates to 'Night Mode': the background transitions to a dark blue/black gradient with twinkling stars, the sun element slides out as the moon element (circular with craters, with a subtle glow/shadow) slides in to the right side of the toggle, and the label below updates to display 'Night Mode'.
